    php://memory  php://temp  php://output  php://input  data://   php: false   elephc: true
    a plain file  php://stdin  php://stdout  php://fd/N  zlib      php: true    elephc: true

php reaches `flock()` through `php_stream_lock`, which a stream only answers when its ops carry a
locking one. Two of those five hold their bytes in memory, two are the output and input layers, and
`data:` is a decoded literal — none of them is a descriptor.
